title: How to secure Calvin Harris presale tickets for first-ever headlining North American tour

 By Madison Kemeny | MKemeny@syracuse.com 
 Calvin Harris has played hundreds of shows in North America over the past 18 years. He has never headlined a full tour of the continent until now. 
 The Scottish DJ and producer announced a 20-date arena run across the U.S. and Canada for spring 2027, with the first show April 1 at TD Garden in Boston and the last May 27 at the Kia Forum in Inglewood, CA. Other stops include Barclays Center in Brooklyn, TD Coliseum in Hamilton, ON, United Center in Chicago and Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle.
 Buy Calvin Harris Tickets How to get Calvin Harris tickets
 Four sales are lined up this week, and all times are local to each venue.
 Reserved by Spotify : This sale started Monday, Oct. 19, at 10 a.m. Eligible U.S. Spotify Premium subscribers can buy through Ticketmaster . Spotify notifies fans by email and in the app, and the limit is two tickets per tour. The window runs through Tuesday, Oct. 20, at 10 a.m.
 Artist presale : This sale opens Tuesday, Oct. 20, at noon. Fans who registered in advance will receive early access through Thursday, Oct. 22, at 10 a.m.
 Live Nation presale : This sale is for select dates and starts Wednesday, Oct. 21, at noon.
 If you don’t have access to the presales or tickets become limited, you can also get tickets through verified resale marketplaces such as Vivid Seats .
 Exclusive discount: First-time Vivid Seats customers can use code SYRACUSE20 for $20 off a $200+ ticket order.
 Limited tickets may also be available via SeatGeek and StubHub . Get $5 off SeatGeek orders of $300+ with code TAKE5 .
 Resale Ticket Platforms Vivid Seats SeatGeek StubHub All‑in pricing ✅ ✅ ✅ Buyer protection ✅ ✅ ✅ Discount $20 off $200+ (SYRACUSE20) $5 off $300+ (TAKE5) ❌ Rare Browse Tickets Browse Tickets Browse Tickets Purchases are backed by buyer guarantees that protect your order if there’s an issue with ticket delivery or validity.
 Any remaining tickets will go on sale to the general public on Thursday, Oct. 22, at noon through Ticketmaster . SeatGeek is the official ticketing partner for the shows at Grand Casino Arena in St. Paul, MN, and the Delta Center in Salt Lake City.
 More about Calvin Harris
 Harris is a 42-year-old DJ and producer with a catalog of nearly 75 million monthly listeners on Spotify , two U.K. No. 1 albums, 11 U.K. No. 1 singles and 31 U.K. Top 10 singles, according to Official Charts . In the U.S., he has 22 Billboard Hot 100 hits, including one No. 1.
 His partners over the years include Rihanna, Mary J. Blige and Dua Lipa. He has also worked with Ellie Goulding and Sam Smith. Songs like “We Found Love” and “This Is What You Came For” with Rihanna, “One Kiss” with Dua Lipa and “I Need Your Love” with Goulding remain staples of his live sets.
 His 2012 album “18 Months” earned him a Guinness World Records title in 2014 for the most U.K. Top 10 singles from one album, with nine.
 Harris hasn’t put out an album of original material since 2022’s “Funk Wav Bounces Vol. 2,” but he has stayed busy with singles. In 2025, he released “Smoke the Pain Away,” then “Blessings,” featuring Clementine Douglas.
 Watch “Blessings” peaked at No. 3 on the U.K. Singles Chart and became his 31st U.K. Top 10 single. More recently, he shared new songs with Jazzy, Kasabian and Jessie Reyez.
